cl.x: Provide Sika® Wonder Wipes where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.01).

Sika® Wonder Wipes are specially formulated to clean hands, tools and surfaces from wet and semi-cured paint, sealant, adhesive, bitumen, expanding foam, oil, grease and even silicone. Particularly useful when there is no water on site.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Cleaning wet and semi-cured paints, sealants, adhesives, bitumen, polyurethanes, expanding foams, polyester fillers and epoxies from hands, tools and surfaces.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

Storage conditions: Store in cool dry conditions away from direct sunlight between +5 °C and +25 °C. Storage outside these parameters will significantly reduce shelf life.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: Tub
Pull off lid and open closure. Find start wipe in centre of roll. Pull out approx 30 cm of wipes and thread through lid. Replace lid immediately and reseal closure.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Limitations Of Use
s: Do not use on porous surfaces such as untreated wood.
Do not dispose of wipes in toilets.
Use only as directed.
Store only in original container.
As with all detergents / products containing detergents, people with sensitive or damaged skin should avoid prolonged contact with skin.
It is the users responsibility to determine suitability for use. If in doubt, contact our Technical Services department for advice.
